title.narrative: Parterskap för Mödrars- nyföddas- och barns hälsa 2013-2015

description.narrative: PMNCH is a coordinating mechanism that builds on UN General Secretary's Global Strtegy for women's and Children's Health and enabels partners to share strategies,align objectives and resourses and agree on interventions to achive more together that being able to achive individually. PMNCH aims at contributing to achieving 16 million lives by 2015.PMNCH secretariat is located at the WHO.

PMNCH är en koordineringsmekanism som bygger på FNs general- sekreterares Globala strategi för mödrars- och barns hälsa. Möjliggör för parterna att dela med sig av strategier, jämka samman mål och resurser och komma överens om interventioner för att uppnå mer tillsammans än vad som är möjligt individuellt. Målet är att rädda 16 miljoner liv till 2015. Sekretariatet är beläget på WHO i Geneve.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The workplan for 2015 was structured around two main objectives namely To contribute to the development and increased political support for an updated Global Strategy for Women's Children's and Adolescent health, with an acccompanied plan for national implementation. The New strategy (GS 2.0) was decided in September 2015. The second objective is to support partners to deliver on RMNCAH objectives including those set out in the GS 2.0. and lastly Countdown to 2015: To host the Countdown to 2015 initiative.
The workplan has been implemented according to plan. In addition the work with a new strategy for 2016-2020 has been elaborated and decided. Sida has entered in a new agreement with PMNCH for the next 4 years.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
